name: Legend of Acrius

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.description:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.description:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Long March
perks.description: Detect enemies on your radar from farther away.

perks.name: Fitted Stock
perks.description:
This stock makes the weapon stable but heavy
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil

flavor: "In the Cabal legend, a hero seeks to possess the sun. He succeeds. Then, he becomes Emperor. The Cabal… are not a subtle people." —Tyra Karn
